name: external-recorder
fault_schedule: Discard acknowledged registration response then replay; SIGKILL registered producer after observed work-finished barrier without terminal delivery; independently SIGKILL recorder process after a synced registration. Separate exact sequence/capacity and malformed-file controls.
assertions: Identical registration retry retains one record; conflicting identity, sequence gaps and capacity overflow reject.
Producer death leaves exact terminal-unobserved set without fabricated durations; unknowns cannot close steady phase.
Recorder death and malformed or unclosed journal fail offline validation.
100 completed registrations in closed steady family satisfy sample eligibility.
limitations: No adapter hook or runtime controller integration; no full acceptance PASS.
Producer work in control is synthetic, not a Temporal operation.
Registration acknowledgment loss is deliberately discarded client response, not injected packet loss.
